approved_scope.title: Python agent core for a self-hosted bot
approved_scope.description: Python agent core for a self-hosted bot
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: The protocol spec and vectors do not change. This change adds the Python agent module and its own module spec under py/specs/agent. Wire bytes are untouched.
acceptance_criteria: AGENT-1, AGENT-1.b, AGENT-1.d, AGENT-4 and the wallet half of AGENT-2 in hi/agent.md, as scoped by algochat#43 (AGENT-2's Raven identity NFT half is out of scope, see plan.md): algochat.agent builds the bot's own Algorand account from its 25-word mnemonic, read only from ALGOCHAT_AGENT_MNEMONIC or an owner-only local file named by ALGOCHAT_AGENT_MNEMONIC_FILE; AgentCore binds an AlgoChat client to that account on operator-supplied algod and indexer clients; unit tests use mocks and public non-secret seeds only; localnet integration tests use throwaway accounts funded from the local network's own KMD wallet only.
